result.description: 27-inch desktop monitor designed for spreadsheets, document work, and multi-window office setups. Features a QHD IPS panel, 100 Hz refresh rate, USB-C video input with 65 W power delivery, adjustable stand, and low blue light mode. Includes HDMI and DisplayPort connectivity, VESA mount support, and a matte anti-glare screen finish.
result.title: Orion Vale 27QN-Stream 27 Inch QHD IPS Office Monitor
